description: This file defines the 'View' class in the Goteo application, responsible for managing the rendering of templates using the Foil templating engine. It handles engine creation, theme management, folder addition, and rendering views with optional event dispatching.

classes.name: View
classes.description: A static class managing the Foil templating engine, themes, and view rendering in the Goteo application.

methods.name: createEngine
methods.description: Initializes and configures a new Foil engine instance with necessary extensions.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Initializes the Foil engine if not already created.

methods.name: addFolder
methods.description: Adds a folder to the template search path.

methods.name: prependFolder
methods.description: Adds a folder to the beginning of the search path.

methods.name: getFolders
methods.description: Retrieves the current list of template folders.

methods.name: loadExtension
methods.description: Loads a given extension into the Foil engine.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a view template with variables and optional event dispatching.

methods.name: getEngine
methods.description: Returns the current Foil engine instance.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Sets the current theme, adjusting template folders accordingly.
